name: @pgilad/pi-vertex-anthropic
description: Pi extension: Claude on Google Cloud Vertex AI via ADC. Uses the official @anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk for real Application Default Credentials (gcloud user creds, service account JSON, GCE/GKE metadata server, workload identity).
author: Gilad Peleg <gilad@giladpeleg.com>
//deps: @anthropic-ai/sdk is a direct dep ONLY to floor @anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk's loose transitive range (>=0.50.3 <1) at >=0.103.0, where the backendMiddleware hook the Vertex URL rewrite needs was introduced. index.ts never imports it; removing it lets the core SDK drift to a version that 404s every request as /v1/v1/messages. Guarded by test/vertex-wire-shape.test.ts.
